name: openUnity
tagline: An AI agent for the Unity Editor
description: Builds and edits Unity scenes from plain language. It runs on the user's computer with a local model through Ollama, works in the open Unity Editor, finds models in Assetra and works with Firebase.

parts.name: open-unity-cli
parts.text: The open-unity command: Unity prompts, rules and skills, the agent's configuration, and how the framework packages work together.

applications.name: openUnity app
applications.text: Web, Android, iOS and desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux) clients built with Angular, Capacitor and Electron by another developer. They connect to the agent over the ai-core HTTP API.

features: Chat with the Unity project in the terminal.
A local model by default: it works offline and the project stays on the computer.
Scene changes go through the Editor, so they can be undone.
Phone and desktop apps can drive an agent that runs on the workstation.
roadmap: The open-unity command on ai-core and ai-ollama: first-run setup and chat
HTTP API for the openUnity apps
Security review before the public release
